outcome: Gestational age at termination of pregnancy
cohort: 110 pregnant women with ultrasonography-documented uterine fibroids diagnosed prenatally or antenatally at a medical college in central India
finding: Pregnancies with fibroids are high-risk pregnancies that are linked to difficulties throughout the antepartum, intrapartum, and postpartum periods, as well as increased chances of cesarean delivery and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most prevalent mode of delivery (61.82%).
